text:
ana-finance: FYI — Neptune Analytics flagged a disputed April invoice and requested a custom credit + Net45 payment terms going forward. They want a one-time concession and extended payment due to procurement cycle. Proposing: $29,600 one-time credit and change terms to Net45 for next 6 months. Need deal-desk approval + legal amendment.
sam-sales: Sales supports; Neptune is negotiating an expanded committed spend for H2. Granting temporary Net45 helps close the annual contract. We verbally promised flexibility during renewal talks.
kevin-salesops: Usage reconciled: billed tokens 920k vs committed 700k. Overage calc = $24,700. Sales allowance (~$8k) wasn't applied, hence gross billed. Proposed credit $29,600 includes onboarding allowance + partial overage write-down. Sheet: https://sheets.internal/redwood/neptune-apr-recon (view).
billing-bot: Invoice summary: ```
Invoice: INV-2026-04-12
Total: $51,300
Lines: Base COMM-700K: $31,000; Overage: $20,300
```
ana-finance: Notes: granting Net45 is a credit risk change; AR and finance must confirm risk limits. Also we should require exec sponsor on the commercial side for extended terms.
maria-cfo: I can approve one-time credits up to $35k with GC/legal sign-off and AR risk sign-off. @yara-legal please draft amendment with non-precedent clause + explicit Net45 end date (6 months). @jorge-ar confirm AR acceptance.
yara-legal: Will draft a short amendment: "One-time reconciliation credit and temporary payment terms (Net45) for a period of six months. This amendment is non-precedential and does not modify Redwood's standard payment or pricing terms." Will attach to DocuSign.
jorge-ar: AR can accept Net45 for six months with approved credit. We'll add a credit hold flag in billing and require PO or signed amendment before posting. GL for credit: 4102. JE template ready.
sam-sales: Customer agrees to sign quickly. They also committed to a $200k annual spend if we accommodate this. I'll include exec sponsor @ceo-cust in the DocuSign when sending.
ana-finance: Approval ask: CFO sign-off for $29,600 credit + temporary Net45 (6 months) pending amendment signature and AR posting.
maria-cfo: Approved on the $29,600 credit and temporary Net45 for 6 months. Legal amendment required and attach DocuSign before AR posts. Add DEALDESK tag and note in concessions log.
yara-legal: Uploaded amendment draft: https://legal.internal/redwood/amendments/neptune-net45-credit-v1.pdf. DocuSign envelope DSGN-445566 created.
billing-bot: DocuSign status: sent. Invoice INV-2026-04-12 flagged PENDING-CREDIT+NET45.
jorge-ar: Once signed we'll post CM-2026-04-NEP and update AR aging subject to Net45 schedule. Will confirm tax treatment before posting.
nana-finance: Thanks team. @sam-sales please own the customer comms and copy finance. Closing thread when credit posted. :white_check_mark:
